integrity: Exact characteristic range, motivic class, and comparison algebra pair use the same definitions; finite-field checks are corroborative and not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Reduced commuting varieties only; no assertion of scheme-theoretic reducedness or variety isomorphism; exclude characteristic two and primes at most the highest symmetric power; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Motivic commuting-tuple profiles of \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)-module extensions and a ten-dimensional nonreconstruction pair
